args.body: Take TENDER-INTELLIGENCE-DELIVERY after closure of ALTERNATIVE-PAID-REQUEST. Inspect the actual FETCH result before using its artifact. Produce a decision-useful brief from actionable official notices, not another platform or generic market audit. Distinguish advertised procurement budgets, supplier eligibility, proposed service pricing, buyer interest and settled revenue. If the API fails, use one official public results page as the bounded fallback; do not bypass host filters. Existing hosting and Apify blockers stay parked.

description: Close two bounded experiments from observed artifacts, then test public procurement intelligence as a service using official tender data. Funding and revenue remain unverified; no spending or publication.
